tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings
tool_schemas.description: Perform user, session, and server-access operations for Inbox MCP, including signing up/signing in, issuing/refreshing/revoking sessions, and creating/updating/deleting servers and access grants; list operations (`list_servers`, `list_server_access`, `list_sessions`) return a page of records ordered by `sort` (default backend order if omitted) with up to `limit` items and a `cursor` to request the next page when more results exist. Returns the created/updated entity for write actions, the requested entity for get actions, or a success confirmation for revoke/delete/sign-out actions, and uses `access_token` to identify the current session for `get_current_user` and other current-user flows. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for missing/invalid required fields (including ID patterns, email format, password length, unknown enum values, or disallowed extra fields), `UNAUTHORIZED` when tokens are missing/invalid/expired or credentials are wrong, `FORBIDDEN` when the signed-in user lacks permission for the target server/user/session, `NOT_FOUND` when a referenced `user_id`/`session_id`/`server_id`/`server_access_id` does not exist or is not visible to the caller, `CONFLICT` when attempting an invalid state transition (e.g., updating/deleting already `deleted` entities or granting access that already exists/has already been revoked), and `RATE_LIMITED` when authentication/session endpoints exceed quota.

action.description: Operation to perform for sign-in, session, and server access management.

user_id.description: User ID (inb_usr_… ULID) for user-scoped operations.

session_id.description: Session ID (inb_sess_… ULID) for session-scoped operations.

server_id.description: Server ID (inb_srv_… ULID) for server-scoped operations.

server_access_id.description: Server access grant ID (inb_sacc_… ULID) for access-scoped operations.

access_token.description: Bearer access token (raw) used to identify the current signed-in session.

refresh_token.description: Refresh token (raw) used to rotate/renew the current session.

auth_provider.description: Authentication provider for the user identity.

server.description: Server fields used when creating or updating a server.

base_url.description: Base URL for the Inbox MCP server.

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata for the server.

access_grant.description: Fields used to grant or update a user's access to a server.

server_id.description: Target server ID to grant access to.

user_id.description: Target user ID to receive access.

owner_user_id.description: Filter servers by owning user ID.

q.description: Free-text query (e.g., name/email) when supported by the backend.

sort.description: Sort order for list operations (prefix with '-' for descending).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings: list_users
tool_schemas.description: List user identities visible to the caller, optionally filtered; refuses unauthenticated requests and never returns password hashes.

access_token.description: Bearer access token (raw) used to authenticate the request.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 50).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination; pass the `next_cursor` from a prior response.

sort.description: Sort order for results (prefix '-' for descending).

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings: get_user
tool_schemas.description: Fetch a single user identity by id; refuses unauthenticated requests and returns 404 if not found or not visible to the caller.

access_token.description: Bearer access token (raw) used to authenticate the request.

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings: disable_user
tool_schemas.description: Transition a user from status='active' to status='disabled'; refuses if the user is not active or the caller lacks permission.

access_token.description: Bearer access token (raw) used to authenticate the request.

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings: enable_user
tool_schemas.description: Transition a user from status='disabled' to status='active'; refuses if the user is not disabled or the caller lacks permission.

access_token.description: Bearer access token (raw) used to authenticate the request.

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings: delete_user
tool_schemas.description: Transition a user from status='active' or 'disabled' to status='deleted'; refuses if already deleted and may revoke the user's active sessions as part of deletion.

access_token.description: Bearer access token (raw) used to authenticate the request.

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings: get_auth_context
tool_schemas.description: Return the calling identity (user), active session, granted scopes/roles, and current rate-limit/quota consumption for the presented access token; refuses invalid, revoked, or expired sessions.

access_token.description: Bearer access token (raw) used to identify the current signed-in session.

metadata.name: Inbox MCP
metadata.description: This backend stores user accounts and their authenticated sessions for signing in and managing access to Inbox MCP servers. The main workflows are creating a user identity, issuing/revoking sessions, and registering/managing servers that a signed-in user can access. Repository: https://github.com/da
